name: capsstack
description: Connect AI agents to CapsStack return briefs and pre-away context.

interface.shortDescription: Save work context and read CapsStack return briefs.
interface.longDescription: CapsStack connects AI agents to the local macOS app through a privacy-preserving CLI. Save concise context before stepping away, check integration health, and review completed or pending return briefs without exposing raw session logs.
defaultPrompt: Save my current work context before I step away.
Show my latest CapsStack return brief.
Check whether CapsStack is ready for agent handoff.
